Judgment:

1. This is a suit for recovery filed on behalf of plaintiff against the defendants, thereby seeking a decree in the sum of Rs.18,75,630/- (Rupees eighteen lacs seventy five thousand six hundred thirty only) with pendente lite and future interest.

2. The facts of the case in brief, as borne out from the record are that plaintiff was desirous of purchasing Creta Hyundai car and as such, she booked the said car on 03.03.2022 with M/s. V.D.
Automobiles at F-6, Udyog Nagar, Metro Station Piller No.319, Peeragarhi, New Delhi-110041 (hereinafter referred to as the 'showroom').
The plaintiff deposited a sum of Rs.21,000/- (Rupees twenty one thousand only) as booking charges with the aforesaid showroom.
The plaintiff was also desirous of obtaining loan for purchase of the aforesaid car.
The pro forma invoice showed the price of the said car to be Rs.18,20,450/- (Rupees eighteen lacs twenty thousand four hundred fifty only).

The plaintiff approached Bank of Baroda (defendant No.2) for obtaining a loan of Rs.15,00,000/-
(Rupees fifteen lacs only).
The price amount was paid to the showroom by plaintiff on 24.06.2022.
The plaintiff took possession of Creta car from the aforesaid showroom.
Later on, the said car was registered with the Motor Vehicle Authority as DL 4CB B2501.

The plaintiff also got the said vehicle i n s u r e d f r o m d e f e n d a n t N o . 1 b y w a y o f a p r i v a t e c a r p a c k a g e p o l i c y b e a r i n g No.11300031220902057972 for the period from 24.06.2022 to 23.06.2025 CS (Comm) 881/2023
Santra
Vs. The New India Assurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.

with policy premium of Rs.45,702/-.
3.
In the intervening night of 08/09.12.2022, the said car while it was lying parked outside the house of plaintiff, was stolen.
Plaintiff immediately reported the matter to the police and got an e-FIR in the matter recorded.
The plaintiff also simultaneously approached the insurance company (defendant No.1) and intimated it about the said car having been stolen.

The police could not trace the said car and filed an 'untrace report' in the court of Ld. Magistrate on 24.01.2023.
4.

After getting certified copy of the 'untrace report' duly accepted by the Ld. Magistrate, the plaintiff pursued her claim with defendant No.1, which culminated into the sanction order for Rs.17,44,310/-
in respect of the said car on 01.05.2023.
The communication in this regard was received by plaintiff from the office of defendant No.1 whereby she was asked to complete certain paper formalities which the plaintiff did on 22.05.2023.
Despite that, defendant No.1 took more than one year in crediting the aforesaid claim amount in the loan account of plaintiff being maintained with defendant No.2 in respect of the said car.

The plaintiff accordingly filed the present suit inter alia seeking as below:-
a) A decree against defendant No.1 for an amount of Rs.18,75,630/- along with pendente lite and future interest till final realization @ 12% per annum;
b) Cost throughout;

5. After getting served with the summons, the defendant No.1 filed the Written Statement.

The sole ground to oppose the claim in the matter by defendant No.1 is that plaintiff herself contributed towards delay in disbursal of the amount of compensation in the matter, as she did not complete the documentation formalities expeditiously after issuance of sanction letter dated 01.05.2023.

6. Defendant No.2/Bank of Baroda did not file the Written Statement in the matter despite repeated opportunities and even stopped appearing in court which led to it being proceeded ex parte vide order dted 05.11.2024.
7.

15. A perusal of copy of the Statement of account of the bank account of plaintiff with defendant No.2/Bank of Baroda reveals that on 21.09.2024 the claim amount was received in the loan account towards satisfaction of the loan account and balance payment of Rs.3,24,266/- (Rupees three lacs twenty four thousand two hundred sixty six only) was credited in the bank account of the plaintiff.
16. A perusal of legal notice sent by plaintiff Ex.PW1/18 also reveals that plaintiff was aggrieved by the action of defendant No.1 in delaying disbursal of the claim amount.

17. In view of the above discussion, the only relief which can be granted to the plaintiff is that the claim amount of Rs.17,44,310/- was due and payable to the plaintiff till the end of May, 2023 which was ultimately credited to her account on 21.09.2024.
Therefore, plaintiff is entitled to interest on the sum of Rs.17,44,310/- @ 9% from 01.06.2023 till 21.09.2024.
